editorialPolicy: MatchApp Ai independent editorial summaries of announced Spotify features. No Spotify Content, user listening history or Spotify recommendation data is stored. Feature availability is not asserted for an individual account.

features.title: Audiobooks expand across more markets
features.eligibility: Spotify plans and audiobook access options vary by country; Brazil was announced among planned Audiobooks in Premium markets.
features.description: Spotify announced a phased expansion of audiobook access toward more than 180 markets by the end of 2026, including more languages and regional catalogs.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can help listeners choose a topic, format and mood, then encourage them to verify the exact audiobook edition in their country.

features.title: Page Match for print, e-book and audio
features.eligibility: Requires a supported title and a compatible Spotify audiobook experience; check your market and account.
features.description: Spotify's Page Match helps eligible readers move between physical or digital text and audiobook listening positions, with expanded page-number support.
features.matchappRelevance: Show format-aware book discovery without claiming that MatchApp Ai synchronizes reading positions.

features.title: Taste Profile beta for personalized listening
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium listeners aged 18 or older in the United States or New Zealand during the announced beta.
features.description: Taste Profile beta lets eligible listeners view and guide Spotify's interpretation of their interests across music, podcasts and audiobooks.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai maintains its own explicit mood and format preferences; it does not access Spotify's private taste profile.

features.title: AI Persona badges for artist identity transparency
features.eligibility: The AI Persona badge is planned for selected artist profiles from September 2026 onward; visibility depends on the artist and Spotify rollout.
features.description: Spotify introduced an AI Persona label intended to identify selected artist profiles using AI-generated identities, alongside broader artist verification and music-credit initiatives.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can encourage listeners to confirm artist identities and source information without labeling anyone as AI-generated on speculation.

features.title: Prompted Playlist for audiobooks
features.eligibility: Eligible Spotify Premium users in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Sweden; beta restrictions apply.
features.description: Listeners can describe the audiobooks they want and receive a personalized audiobook playlist within Spotify, with optional automatic refresh.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can independently recommend book ideas while respecting exact edition, country and rights verification.

features.title: Talk to Spotify conversational discovery
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium subscribers aged 18 or older in the United States, Ireland and Sweden; English-language experience in the announced rollout.
features.description: Eligible Spotify listeners can type or speak follow-up questions within Spotify to explore music, podcasts and audiobooks.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai's separate entertainment assistant does not control Spotify playback or account actions.

features.title: DJ beta in Brazilian Portuguese and more languages
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium listeners in Brazil and other supported markets; DJ remains a beta and availability can depend on account, country and device.
features.description: Spotify expanded its personalized DJ beta to Brazilian Portuguese, French, German and Italian, combining listening-history-based music choices with commentary and requested moods.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can guide listeners toward music moods and artists; it does not operate or impersonate Spotify's native DJ.

features.title: Spotify music and podcast recommendations in Claude
features.eligibility: Available to eligible Spotify listeners using the Claude integration; account connection and Spotify Premium features vary by plan and region.
features.description: Spotify launched an official integration in Claude, enabling connected listeners to request personalized music and podcast suggestions and move to Spotify for playback.
features.matchappRelevance: This integration belongs to Spotify and Claude, not MatchApp Ai; our recommendations and outbound discovery links remain independent.

features.title: Prompted Playlist for podcasts
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium users in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Sweden; English-language beta.
features.description: Spotify expanded prompted playlists to podcast discovery, allowing eligible users to describe subjects and topics they want to hear about.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can surface original topic-based listening suggestions without claiming it generates Spotify-hosted playlists.

features.title: SongDNA reveals collaborators, samples and cover versions
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium mobile listeners globally on supported tracks; availability of credits and creative connections differs per song.
features.description: Spotify's SongDNA explores the writers, producers, collaborators, samples and cover recordings connected to a track within the Now Playing view.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can help users search for a genre, performer or related music idea but should not copy Spotify's SongDNA network or credits without authorized sources.

features.title: Prompted Playlist for music
features.eligibility: Spotify Premium beta; the February expansion included the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia and Sweden, with availability changing by market.
features.description: Spotify's Prompted Playlist helps eligible listeners turn natural-language music moods, moments or activities into tailored playlists.
features.matchappRelevance: MatchApp Ai can assist with mood and genre discovery; playlists are created and managed by Spotify itself.
